profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer, TLM at Uber
profile.summary: Software developer working on building the next generation of Uber’s compute infrastructure.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.insights: Go (Programming Language), Distributed Systems and +1 skill

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
As part of the platforms engineering team, I support the release of Synopsys EDA products on Unix platforms. I am responsible for:

 - Porting of flagship place & route products to various UNIX platforms, including Oracle Solaris, IBM AIX and SUSE Linux.
 - Porting lead of newly acclimated product.
 - Working with the build/release teams to manage product releases on the UNIX platforms.
 - Migration of products to new build tools.
 - Developing scripts for streamlining the porting flow.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design, implementation, and maintenance of automatic industrial test & measurement software using tools such as C/C++, LabVIEW, and Keil C. Examples include:

 - GPIB communication software on Solaris based ATEs for IC testing.
 - DUT control software for mass production testing 802.11ac wi-fi chips.
 - PXI-based contact force and resistance test systems on a full fledged mass production line for
pogo pins.
 - Fully automatic laser dicing system for dicing sapphire LED wafers on a mass production line.
 - PXI-based ADC/DAC bench test system for verification of SoC function blocks.
 - PXI-based laser diode bench tester for measuring electrical and optical properties of laser
diode devices.
 - PXI-based laser diode mass production test system for testing electrical and optical
properties of laser diode devices.
 - FPGA-based contact force and resistance testers for mass production testing of tact switches.
 - FPGA-based wind-tunnel controller for mass production testing hydrodynamic properties of
fans used in electronic devices.

In addition to industrial test systems, I also designed firmware for various 8051 microcontroller-based in-house products, examples include:

 - Real-time temperature controller for ±0.1 degC temperature control.
 - Real-time edge position controller for accurate alignment of sheets on industrial rollers.
 - High channel count simultaneous DAQ system for high-throughput distributed data
acquisition.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Developed a Monte Carlo simulation program in Python/C for calculating molecular line emission from astronomical objects:
- Calculates non-thermal equilibrium radiative transfer in molecular gas, using 1-D and 3-D hierarchical models.
- Scaled the program to handle large models by using distributed (via MPI) and multi-threaded (POSIX threads) workers
- Program was used to model radio astronomical data emitted from objects such as molecular clouds in star forming regions
